risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (369.92), flat yield curve signaling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, and earnings event in 27 days creating binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 bullish momentum with MACD crossover and three white soldiers pattern offer short-term entry signal in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), with price near support at 190.33 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all key moving averages (SMA-21, EMA-50, EMA-200), RSI-14 at 39.95 shows no intermediate confirmation, CMF negative despite volume spike, thick ichimoku cloud overhead, and severe macro headwinds (VIX 369.92, rising dollar, recession yield curve) with earnings binary risk in 27 days eliminate confluence needed for swing entry.
